sourceSystem.name: Compact hyperbolic Coxeter 5-cube (Jacquemet-Tschantz Gamma1)
notes: The graph is the unique compact hyperbolic Coxeter 5-cube Gamma_1 from Jacquemet-Tschantz, Figure 3.
Unlabeled solid Coxeter graph edges are m=3; omitted edges are m=2; dotted edges are represented as Coxeter-matrix 'inf' entries.
Dotted diagonal edges (g2,g8) and (g6,g9) use cosh d = sqrt(2(5+sqrt(13)))/4.
Dotted boundary edges (g0,g1), (g3,g4), and (g5,g7) use cosh e = (1+sqrt(13))/4.

sourceRefs.citation: Matthieu Jacquemet and Steven T. Tschantz, All hyperbolic Coxeter n-cubes, Journal of Combinatorial Theory, Series A 158 (2018), 387-406.
sourceRefs.notes: Supports the compact 5-cube Coxeter graph Gamma_1 and its dotted-edge weights.
